Top-end design position

This is the highest practical single-file HTML version. It is strong for design, testing, audit prototypes and anonymised data capture. For live clinical deployment, migrate this schema to FileMaker, REDCap, Django/PostgreSQL, or NHS-approved infrastructure.

Document controls

Preview


 
Evidence file import
Drop photos, screenshots, PDF, Word or Excel files here. Files are previewed where possible, classified, linked to patient/procedure/follow-up records, and exported with metadata.
Images and PDFs can be previewed in-browser. Word/Excel files are stored and indexed as attachments; CSV/text files can also feed structured data import. Native .xlsx/.docx text extraction requires a server-side parser or approved library, so this prototype stores them as source files with metadata.
Current patient evidence

 
Smart import centre
Drop JSON / CSV / TSV files here or use Choose files. This importer previews before committing, infers modules, maps common columns, detects duplicates, and can import one record, selected rows, or full files.
Recommended workflow: choose file → inspect mapping/status → commit. Nothing is written to the registry until you press Commit.

AI Scribe — transcript to structured IR clinic note

       
Governance mode: this single-file prototype does not send data to an external AI model. It provides the workflow, fields, audit structure and local rule-based draft generation. V16 Intelligent Procedure Pack & Operational Workflow Engine
Generate the complete pre-, intra- and post-procedure operational pack from the current patient, guided clinic pathway and signed procedural plan.
Consultant-controlled prototype

    
Safety principle: generated content is a preparation aid. Blood thresholds, anticoagulation instructions, medicines, devices and discharge criteria must be checked against current Trust policy and the individual patient before use.

AI Clinical Import

    
AI Clinical Import is a clinician-controlled extraction assistant. It does not make treatment decisions. All extracted fields require human review before being saved to the registry.

    
Governance mode: this is a local, browser-based, rule-assisted prototype. It does not call external AI APIs and does not send data outside the browser. Nothing is written to a patient record until each field is reviewed and a commit is confirmed.
